dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Mmm, simply exquisite. As amazing as ever!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Escoffier, have you ever considered starring in your own film? Ah, I can see it now — "Valse en Cuisine," a riveting tale about the art of extreme cooking! I'm sure it would be a hit!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: As it happens, I'm already doing something similar. A brand consultant has been filming my training sessions with students and incorporating them into films about Fontainian cuisine...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Oh, no. No, no, no, no. A documentary won't do. I'm talking about something with a bit more... drama! Your experiences as a chef could be turned into a scintillating story... In fact, I'll even write it myself!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Before you finalize it, please let me review the culinary terms — especially when it comes to how ingredients are handled, the timings, and the quantities...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: #And actually, I think I'd like to bring in {NICKNAME} and Paimon as directors. Something tells me that the three of you working together would really get the creative sparks flying. We could create something truly magical here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No problem! That said, now that we've been granted Director Furina's approval, we'll really have to step up our game!

choices.text: Director Furina, show us the way!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Excellent! I believe in you both!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: The gateau was sublime as ever, Escoffier. Now, about time we got to work!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: I'll start drafting the script on the side while serving as the consultant for Movie Masterpieces. Wish me luck!

choices.text: We may be rookies, but we'll give it our all!
